entries.5d1b00bdecf41e3c: A reportable segment that manufactures and sells pharmaceuticals, medical diagnostic reagents, active pharmaceutical ingredients, medical devices and supplies, and more. It is carried out by Alfresa Pharma Corporation and Alfresa Fine Chemical Corporation (active pharmaceutical ingredients for prescription drugs), and by Qingdao Naisike Medical Materials Co., Ltd. in China (medical devices and supplies), among others. Net sales to external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥37,181 million (¥37,690 million for the fiscal year ended March 2025), and segment profit (operating profit basis) was ¥1,203 million (¥1,294 million for the fiscal year ended March 2025). The securities report states that sales decreased because of lower pharmaceutical sales due to drug price revisions and the effect of the selected treatment system for long-listed products introduced in October 2024, and a decline in demand for diagnostic agents, despite growth in active pharmaceutical ingredient sales and efforts to hold down selling, general and administrative expenses. In February 2026, it launched in Japan Nefy Nasal Spray, an adjunctive treatment for anaphylaxis.

entries.83ef58a66a770c1f: In April 2016, Alfresa Co., Ltd. absorbed Alfresa Nikken Sangyo Co., Ltd. through a merger, and in October of the same year, it absorbed CS Yakuhin Co., Ltd. through a merger. In July 2016, the Kyushu-area Medical Pharmaceuticals Wholesale Business of TS Alfresa Co., Ltd. was succeeded by Alfresa Co., Ltd. through a business transfer, and in July 2018, the Hokkaido-area business of the same kind of Kowa Yakuhin Co., Ltd. was succeeded by Alfresa Co., Ltd. through a business transfer, respectively. In October 2018, Kowa Yakuhin Co., Ltd. merged with Odajima Co., Ltd., and changed its name to Tohoku Alfresa Co., Ltd.
entries.8669c35c9d03baee: This reportable segment wholesales prescription drugs, medical testing reagents, and medical devices and materials to medical institutions and others, and it has the largest external customer revenue of the four reportable segments. External customer revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥2,763,082 million (¥2,621,062 million for the fiscal year ended March 2025), and segment profit (on an operating profit basis) was ¥33,297 million (¥33,055 million for the fiscal year ended March 2025). Regional wholesalers, centered on Alfresa Co., Ltd. and including Shikoku Alfresa Co., Ltd., TS Alfresa Co., Ltd., Meisho Co., Ltd., Ryuyaku Co., Ltd. and Tohoku Alfresa Co., Ltd., are responsible for this segment. The securities report states that, although the business environment was difficult, with the negative impact of the mid-year revision of drug prices in April 2025 and soaring logistics costs, including labor costs, it achieved revenue growth exceeding market growth through the promotion of its Neo Primary strategy and an increase in the handling of limited-distribution products such as specialty drugs.
entries.8b924f35dfe1c4f0: This reportable segment wholesales general medicines, health foods and healthcare-related products, and is handled by its consolidated subsidiary Alfresa Healthcare Co., Ltd. External customer revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥266,626 million (¥265,275 million for the fiscal year ended March 2025), and segment profit (on an operating profit basis) was ¥3,012 million (¥2,950 million for the fiscal year ended March 2025). The securities report states that, in addition to revenue growth from expanding sales channels, logistics costs rose but the company focused on cost control, so both revenue and profit exceeded the previous year.

entries.a9aeef899ad80d97: The annual securities report states that the “25-27 Medium-Term Management Plan” sets out the group's aim to seamlessly provide, across the whole group, drug introduction and development, manufacturing through logistics and sales, post-marketing surveys, and last-mile delivery. This approach is called TSCS (Total Supply Chain Service). In January 2026, the company began providing the “PATH-Solution” platform service, which supports the entry into Japan of overseas emerging biopharmaceutical companies and others. In November 2025, the company resolved that four companies, including itself, would enter into an agreement concerning the establishment of a joint venture to manufacture active pharmaceutical ingredients and formulations of biosimilars (follow-on biologics).

The [[term:segment|reportable segments]] consist of four segments, namely the Prescription Drug Wholesale Business, the Self-Medication Wholesale Business, the Pharmaceutical Manufacturing Business and the Dispensing Pharmacy Business, plus an “Other” category that includes the Regenerative Medicine-Related Business. In June 2025, the company transitioned from a company with a Board of Corporate Auditors to a company with an Audit and Supervisory Committee.
